title: Executor Result Schema
description: Generic executor result contract for Portable App Builder Core. Agent-neutral. Provider-specific result schemas (e.g., agy-result-schema.json) are instances or extensions of this schema.

status.description: Execution outcome. SUCCESS = implementation complete and tests passing. FAILED = implementation incomplete or tests failing. ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKER = implementation requires architecture boundary change.

files_changed.description: List of files changed (relative paths from workspace root). Must be within approved scope (apps/<slug>/**).

exit_code.description: Process exit code (0 = success, non-zero = failure).

result.description: Test outcome. 'passed' = exit_code 0 and assertions satisfied. 'failed' = non-zero exit or assertion failure.

tests.description: List of tests executed with exact commands, exit codes, and results.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings or observations (e.g., deprecations, performance notes, edge cases encountered).

architecture_blockers.description: Concrete architecture boundary changes required (only when status = ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKER). Each item describes a specific decision the Orchestrator must make.

recommended_follow_up.description: Bounded next steps or investigations recommended (e.g., additional tests, documentation updates, performance optimization).

architecture_blockers.description: ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKER status requires at least one architecture blocker description.

files_changed.description: ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKER should not have files changed (executor stops before implementation).

tests.description: SUCCESS requires at least one test executed and passed.
